title: Vite web app
description: React, Vue or Svelte with Vite. Installs packages only when needed. The 'lan' profile makes it reachable from a phone.

title: FastAPI + Vite + Redis
description: A Python API and a web front end with a shared Redis. The 'lan' profile binds both to the network.

title: Laravel on Laragon
description: Pins Laragon's PHP and MySQL versions, installs only when needed, and migrates once MySQL is up.

title: NestJS + PostgreSQL
description: PostgreSQL in Docker (or your own, shared), migrations as a task, then the API.

title: Django
description: Checks the virtual environment, runs migrations as a task, then runserver.

title: ASP.NET Core
description: dotnet watch run on a fixed URL. Ready when Swagger answers.

title: Spring Boot
description: Maven wrapper. Ready when the log says the application started.

title: Docker Compose
description: docker compose up in the foreground, and docker compose down on Stop.

title: Flutter (Android)
description: Boots an Android emulator, waits for it, then runs the app. iOS needs macOS.

title: React Native (Android)
description: Emulator, then the Metro bundler, then installs the app as a task.

title: Desktop app
description: Any GUI app without a port (Electron, WPF, WinForms). Ready after a short delay.

title: Two projects together
description: One click for two apps that share a database.
